name: Australia Online
summary: Independent ISP, Australia Online Pty Ltd (ACN 062 945 242); held aol.com.au in early 1998 and explicitly disclaimed any affiliation with America Online; domain passed to AOL Australia by Nov 1998.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 29 Apr 1998 (aol.com.au, 'Welcome to Australia Online'); actual founding predates the archive and is unverified.
aol.com.au serving AOL Australia content by the 11 Nov 1998 capture; the independent's domain was taken over at AOL's Australian launch.

Australia Online Pty Ltd (ACN 062 945 242) was deregistered ~Jun 2000 (ASIC notice 18 Apr 2000, Commonwealth Gazette 28 Apr 2000) — the independent company wound up after losing its domain, distinct from AOL's ongoing service.

refs.label: Australia Online Pty Ltd (Wayback 29 Apr 1998): 'not affiliated with America Online Inc. or the AOL Australia Service' (ACN 062 945 242)
aol.com.au (Wayback 11 Nov 1998): first AOL-content capture, marking the domain handover
